item.content:encoded:
I really can't do anything BUT -1 this in this current form. There are serious tone issues, the TERRIBLE expungement - and in the containment procedures! - and a few lines that just shatter the ENTIRE article on their own.

We tried to take a sample, but the damn stuff animated too quickly, escaping the labs and rejoining the SCP-790's main body before we could stop it.

I'm sorry, but THIS LINE ALONE MAKES THIS THING KETER. Assuming we take it as read that this even happens, this means the blood animated, LEFT THE TESTING LAB, WENT THROUGH THE FOUNDATION FACILITY, and then ENTERED A SUPPOSEDLY SECURE CONTAINMENT ROOM - all on its own, without the Foundation able to do anything to stop it. That's not JUST bad writing, that also reclassifies the entire SCP into something totally different.

Really unfortunate because the last line is REALLY clever, and would be a great capstone for a better article.
